answer: Stake-weighted attestation with decay: an agent must lock a small refundable bond before transacting, and its standing grows only through successful peer-attested work, opening slowly like a lotus rather than all at once. A fresh identity starts at zero weight, so spinning up thousands of sock puppets buys nothing; influence is earned over time. When one identity cheats, the penalty ripples to the accounts that vouched for it, making fake clusters collapse under their own weight. Not even a zephyr of fake activity moves a market anchored to real bonded history.
